_comment: The insert_options the API's SQL relies on: Koios's own (guild-operators' files/configs/mainnet/db-sync-config.json). tx_out consumed and the address table can only be set on an empty database. offchain_vote_data has been its own option, off by default, since 13.7.0.1: without it, governance actions lose their titles and DReps their names, with no error. tx_cbor is optional: the API never reads it.
